<USER_REQUEST>
Project: "The Sweet Oven", a bakery website. Use Bootstrap 5.3.3 via CDN, HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript only. No other libraries.

Build the shared layer:
1. css/style.css, loaded AFTER Bootstrap. CSS variables: cream #FFF8EE (background), brown #4A2C1D (text), caramel #B5601E (buttons/accents), pink #F3B6C0 (highlights). Style fonts (Google Fonts with fallbacks), buttons, cards, form inputs, visible focus states, good contrast.
2. Header: logo, "The Sweet Oven" name, Bootstrap navbar with Home, Menu, Offers, Login, Cart. Collapses to a hamburger on mobile.
3. Footer: opening hours, phone, links to About, Contact, FAQ, Reviews, My orders, and a copyright line.
4. Two versions: index.html (links like pages/menu.html, css/style.css) and pages/ (links like ../index.html, ../css/style.css). Relative paths only.
5. A simple SVG logo in images/logo.svg.
6. Create pages/login.html, pages/my-orders.html and pages/reviews.html as placeholders that use the pages/ header, footer and CSS.
7. Put a comment "COPY FROM HERE" and "COPY TO HERE" around each header and footer block.
Use semantic <header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>. Keep the code simple and commented.

args.CommandLine:
$files = @('index.html', 'pages/login.html', 'pages/my-orders.html', 'pages/reviews.html')
foreach ($f in $files) {
  $c = Get-Content $f -Raw
  $hasBoot = $c -match 'bootstrap@5\.3\.3/dist/css/bootstrap\.min\.css'
  $hasBootJs = $c -match 'bootstrap@5\.3\.3/dist/js/bootstrap\.bundle\.min\.js'
  $bootPos = $c.IndexOf('bootstrap.min.css')
  $stylePos = $c.IndexOf('style.css')
  $copyFrom = ([regex]::Matches($c, 'COPY FROM HERE')).Count
  $copyTo = ([regex]::Matches($c, 'COPY TO HERE')).Count
  $hasSemantic = ($c -match '<header') -and ($c -match '<nav') -and ($c -match '<main') -and ($c -match '<footer')
  $hasAbsPath = $c -match '(href|src)="/'
  Write-Output "$f | BootCSS:$hasBoot | BootJS:$hasBootJs | StyleAfterBoot:$($stylePos -gt $bootPos) | CopyFrom:$copyFrom | CopyTo:$copyTo | Semantic:$hasSemantic | RootAbsPaths:$hasAbsPath"
}
